**Returns:**

[ColumnDefinition](./database.columndefinition.md)

The new column, for chaining.

## Remarks

Compiles to whatever each dialect requires: `bigserial` on Postgres, `bigint unsigned auto_increment` on MySQL, and `integer primary key autoincrement` on sqlite — the only spelling sqlite treats as a true rowid alias.
